pro_vente.how_3_text: Put the calculated chance against your licensed operator’s odds. You make the call.
pro_vente.faq_cancel_q: Can I cancel whenever I want?
pro_vente.faq_cancel_a: Yes. You cancel at any time, free of charge and online, from “My account”. Nothing more is charged after you cancel.
pro_vente.faq_cancel_link: The details for each plan length are in the Terms
pro_vente.faq_where_q: Where do I place my bets?
pro_vente.faq_where_a: With your licensed operator. IASHARK takes no bets and manages no player accounts: we publish analyses.
pro_vente.faq_where_anj: In France, the odds shown are taken from operators licensed by the ANJ. When none of them offers the match, the odds are marked indicative and no operator is named.
pro_vente.faq_age_q: How old do I need to be?
pro_vente.faq_age_a: 18 or over. The service is for adults only, like sports betting.
pro_vente.tools_sub: Four tools built on the model’s probabilities: detect, assess, combine, measure.
